title: The eval system (golden set)
html:
English | Português (Brasil)

The eval system (golden set)

evals/ is the kit's regression corpus: every skill carries fixtures that pin its behavior against real scenarios. The checker is deterministic Go (internal/core/eval) — the same code validates every run, no LLM judge.

Fixture anatomy

evals/gm-<skill>/fixture-N/
  input/            # the workspace state BEFORE the skill runs (required)
  criteria.yaml     # the checks (required) — validated by the Go checker
  output-expected/  # the golden final state (optional — see negative fixtures)

The skill is invoked against input/; the checker validates the resulting workspace against criteria.yaml. The contract enforced by the Go suite (corpus_selfscore_test.go): every fixture must self-score PASS — the checks must hold against input/ overlaid with output-expected/.

Negative fixtures (abort/error scenarios) omit output-expected/ on purpose and declare mode: manual: the checks assert what must not exist (not_file_exists, not_contains) against the bare input state.

A fixture that cannot self-score yet carries .self-score-skip with a one-line reason — an empty marker fails the suite.

The check types

Type Asserts
file_exists / not_file_exists artifact exists / must not exist
dir_has_files directory is non-empty
contains / not_contains pattern present / absent in a file
section_exists markdown section (## Title) present
section_order sections appear in the declared order
id_sequence IDs follow the regex sequence (allow_gaps supported)
cross_ref IDs cited in a file trace back to declared sources
line_count_range file size within min/max lines
table_has_columns markdown table declares the expected columns
no_todos no TODO/FIXME left in the artifact
frontmatter_valid YAML front matter parses
mermaid_valid Mermaid block is not broken
reference_match content matches the declared reference

Severity is error (blocks) or warning (records).

How to run

  • Deterministic check: golmet eval <fixture-dir> --workspace <workspace> (--json for machine output) — runs criteria.yaml against the workspace.
  • Agent-driven regression: the gm-skill-eval skill / gm_eval MCP tool invokes the target skill against input/ and scores the output with the same checker, writing an EVAL_REPORT_*.md.
  • CI: the Go suite (go test ./...) runs the checker's selftest plus the corpus self-score over the whole evals/ tree — fixture authoring mistakes fail the build, no agent needed.

golden-human

evals/golden-human/ holds human-maintained cases collected from real incidents — the protection against circularity (agents grading their own homework). Agents never write there; see its README.
